templates.title: See a flow run instantly (no setup)
templates.use_case: Click Use, then press Run — a formatted summary appears right away. The fastest way to watch a flow work end to end, with nothing to connect.
templates.description: A built-in sample dataset (JSON) flows into a Render-text step that turns the rows into a tidy bullet-point summary. No accounts, no triggers, no configuration — fork it and hit Run to see output immediately. The ideal first flow.

templates.title: Website form → Slack message
templates.use_case: Get a Slack message the moment an external system fires a webhook at you, so no event slips through.
templates.description: Catches an incoming HTTP POST and posts its JSON body to a Slack channel. render_text renders the payload into a string Slack can display. Useful for piping alerts from external systems (monitoring, build CI, Stripe events) into your team chat.

templates.title: New email → Slack alert
templates.use_case: Get a Slack ping for matching emails (a sales enquiry, a booking, an invoice) shortly after they arrive.
templates.description: Polls Gmail every 5 minutes for messages from the last few minutes. for_each expands the matching IDs to full messages, unwrap_results flattens them into rows, and render_text joins one line per message into a single Slack post. A short poll window means an overlap can occasionally re-notify a message.

templates.title: Stripe payment → Slack ping
templates.use_case: Get a Slack message for every successful Stripe payment, each one exactly once.
templates.description: Polls Stripe for new payment_intent.succeeded events and posts one Slack message per payment. Demonstrates the cursor-dedupe pattern: the poll reads its cursor from a STRIPE_EVENT_CURSOR secret and saves the newest event id back after each round, so nothing fires twice. Swap the event types for failed invoices or new subscriptions.

templates.title: Daily reminder to your phone (ntfy)
templates.use_case: Get a notification pushed to your phone every morning — no accounts to connect, just subscribe to a topic in the free ntfy app.
templates.description: A daily cron trigger fires a single ntfy push to a topic you choose (default server: ntfy.sh). Change the topic and message, then subscribe to the same topic in the ntfy app to receive it. The simplest scheduled notification — zero external accounts.

templates.title: Daily numbers → Slack each morning
templates.use_case: Post a short daily summary from your database to Slack every morning — e.g. 'Last 24h: 37 new orders'.
templates.description: Runs a SELECT every morning at 09:00, renders the result into a summary line with render_text, and posts it to Slack. Wire your own SQL + channel; the rest stays.

templates.title: Daily breakdown by category → Slack
templates.use_case: Post a daily summary grouped by a category (sales by country, signups by plan) to Slack each morning.
templates.description: Every morning, queries yesterday's orders, groups them by country with sum/avg/count, then renders one line per country and posts the whole block to Slack. Shows group_aggregate feeding render_text — the reducer that turns many rows into one message.

templates.title: Daily Google Sheet → PDF in your inbox
templates.use_case: Wake up to a PDF of yesterday's spreadsheet in your inbox — perfect for a daily comments digest, sales recap, or any dashboard you maintain in a Sheet.
templates.description: Cron-fires every morning, exports a Google Sheet as a PDF, and emails it to you as an attachment. Two nodes: sheets_export_pdf renders the PDF into the run's scratch sandbox; gmail_send_email picks it up via its variadic attachments port. Paste a sheet URL straight into the export node — the drop extracts the file ID for you.

templates.title: Tidy a spreadsheet → email the summary
templates.use_case: Clean up a messy Excel file (rename columns, drop blanks, total things up) and email yourself the summary.
templates.description: Reads an .xlsx, renames + selects columns, filters incomplete rows, totals what's left, renders a plain-text summary with render_text, and emails it via Gmail. A full cleaning pipeline with a non-Slack outbound.

templates.title: Collect contact-form entries (no setup)
templates.use_case: Get a ready-made web form on a link and have every submission saved to a private list — no website, no database, nothing to connect.
templates.description: A hosted intake form (public_form webhook) writes each submission into the built-in per-workspace store via builtin_store_append. Zero external dependencies — the fastest way to start collecting structured data.

templates.title: Route form submissions by topic (no setup)
templates.use_case: Collect form submissions and automatically sort them into separate lists by topic — sales here, support there, everything else in a catch-all.
templates.description: A hosted intake form whose submissions fan out by their 'topic' field into separate built-in store tables. route_rows does the N-way split (first matching filter wins; unmatched rows fall to 'default'). Zero external setup.

templates.title: Extract structured data from text (AI)
templates.use_case: Turn messy incoming text (an email, a note, a pasted receipt) into a clean table automatically, using AI.
templates.description: Posts free text to a webhook; Claude turns it into structured rows; parse_json reads the model's JSON (stripping any Markdown code fence automatically) and appends the rows to the built-in store. The 'messy text in, clean table out' pattern. Needs an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret.

templates.title: Save incoming emails to a spreadsheet
templates.use_case: Automatically log matching emails (invoices, enquiries, receipts) to a Google Sheet so you have a tidy record.
templates.description: Polls Gmail every 5 minutes and appends recent matching messages to a Google Sheet. for_each fetches each message; unwrap_results flattens the per-item results into rows; compute_rows + map_rows keep just from/subject/received. A short poll window can occasionally re-log a message.

templates.title: Import a spreadsheet into a database
templates.use_case: Turn rows from an Excel file into searchable database records you can query and report on.
templates.description: Load rows from an .xlsx file in your workspace into a SQLite table. Renames the 'first_name' column to 'name' on the way through; remove or extend the map_rows node to match your own schema.

templates.title: Tidy a contact list: dedupe + sort
templates.use_case: Clean a contact list — remove duplicate people and sort it — and save the tidy version, no database required.
templates.description: Reads contacts from an .xlsx, drops duplicate rows (keeping the most recent per email), sorts the survivors by name, and saves the clean list to the built-in store. Shows dedupe_rows and sort_rows back to back — the two workhorses of list hygiene.

templates.title: Keep a database in sync with a spreadsheet
templates.use_case: Whatever your team edits in a Google Sheet stays mirrored to your database — runs on a schedule, no duplicate rows.
templates.description: Reads a Google Sheet on a schedule, upserts every row into a Postgres table (so re-runs don't create duplicates). Perfect for ops teams maintaining a master list in Sheets that downstream services consume from the DB.

templates.title: Save incoming events to a database
templates.use_case: Collect events from another tool (payments, sign-ups, alerts) into one database table you can report on.
templates.description: Receive a JSON webhook POST and insert it as a row in an events table. Use case: collect Stripe / GitHub / internal-service events into one analytics table without writing a custom collector.

templates.title: Enrich spreadsheet rows with database data
templates.use_case: Combine a Google Sheet with matching database records and save the merged result back — runs hourly.
templates.description: Hourly: read a Google Sheet, left-join each row against a Postgres lookup table, upsert the enriched result back to Postgres. Shows join_rows in a real ETL position.

templates.title: Copy a Notion database into your database
templates.use_case: Keep a database copy of a Notion database so you can run reports Notion can't do on its own.
templates.description: Hourly upsert every Notion page from a database into a Postgres table. Lets you run analytics queries Notion's API can't easily serve.

templates.title: New GitHub issue → Slack
templates.use_case: For developer teams: post new GitHub issues to a Slack triage channel as they come in.
templates.description: Receive a GitHub issue webhook, render the payload into one Slack line with render_text, and post it to your triage channel. Configure the repo's webhook URL to the flow's /trigger endpoint and you're routing.

templates.title: Slack @mention → GitHub issue
templates.use_case: For developer teams: turn a 'hey can someone look at X' Slack mention into a tracked GitHub issue.
templates.description: When @-mentioned in Slack, create a GitHub issue with the mention text. compute_rows builds the title and body; render_text feeds the body in as a clean string. Routes chat scrollback into a tracked queue.

templates.title: New push → Slack alert
templates.use_case: For developer teams: post a Slack alert whenever commits are pushed to your repo.
templates.description: Listens to GitHub push webhooks and posts a one-line Slack alert naming the branch, pusher, and commit count. render_text turns the push event into the message. Narrow it to one branch by adding a split_rows on row.ref and wiring only the 'matched' port onward.
